page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Spermiogenesis
steps.why: A round spermatid cannot swim, so it must first be rebuilt into a streamlined cell with a tail.
common_mistakes: Confusing it with spermatogenesis, the whole process of sperm formation.
Making it the release step. That is spermiation.
steps.memory_tip: Spermiogenesis makes the shape; spermiation sets it free.
lines: Spermiogenesis is the process in which

steps.label: Spermiation
steps.why: The sperm are held by the Sertoli cells until they are ready, and spermiation is the moment they are let go.
common_mistakes: Saying the sperm are released into the epididymis. They are released from the tubule.
Giving only one of the two definitions.
steps.memory_tip: Spermiation is release from the seminiferous tubule.
steps.margin_note: Keep the contrast in the same words.

lines.text: Spermiation is their release from the tubules

insider_note: The two words differ by three letters and are one step apart. Genesis is the change of shape; -ation is the release.
